epistemic_boundary: All cause ratings are descriptive POST_FIT_RESIDUAL_DIAGNOSTIC statuses only. No multivariable regression, new coefficient fit, predictor synthesis, causal theorem, or new generator is authorized by this checkpoint.

primary_diagnostics.assembly_active_set: D1/D2 class-count vectors are identical on 73.61% of teachers. When they differ, D2 residual advantage is essentially uncorrelated with active-set change. Ordered path, tie count and second-best margin are NOT_AVAILABLE from the unmodified frozen solver.
primary_diagnostics.feature_geometry: Feature covariance rotates materially at the earliest radii but nested-window principal rotations are <=0.43 degrees for D1/D2; covariance effective rank stays near 2.2. Feature-geometry drift does not track frozen coefficient steps consistently.
primary_diagnostics.finite_scale: Absolute residual correlates positively with 1/R (D1 Pearson 0.54680; D2 0.54412; D3 0.57251, all p<2e-12) and declines strongly from small radii before a large-radius rebound.
primary_diagnostics.packet_mixture: Deployed class-mixture total variation is largest at small radii and contracts strongly with scale. D1 residual-RMSE step tracks mixture TV descriptively (Spearman rho 0.64545, p 0.03196), but frozen coefficient steps do not.
primary_diagnostics.phase: Phase-mean residual standard deviation is about 0.39 of overall residual standard deviation for D1/D2; P02 has a persistent negative residual. Equal phase weights at every radius prevent phase-mixture change from explaining scale drift.
primary_diagnostics.unexplained: Residual MSE/bias rebound at R=448/640 after class-mixture TV and covariance rotations are already comparatively small, leaving a diagnostically unresolved component.
